claim_being_audited: The Actor recommends certifying the model for launch on the theory that aggregate readiness and rehearsal results are sufficient support, with the rideshare safety regression handled through documentation/monitoring context.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material segment weaknesses are disclosed in that current documentation or covered by an approved mitigation before launch.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Absent evidence of current disclosure or approved mitigation, aggregate pass and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents are not enough to satisfy the policy threshold.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release/model-card documentation showing current evaluation results and explicit disclosure of the rideshare safety regression for the named launch use case.
Provide approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance covering the rideshare safety regression before launch.
Provide the review/approval record showing that the disclosed limitation or mitigation was accepted under the release policy.
specific_concerns: Aggregate readiness passed, but admissible evidence also shows a named subgroup weakness: the rideshare safety support slice is 1.4 percentage points below the warning threshold.
The governing policy requires material segment weaknesses to be disclosed in current release documentation or covered by approved mitigation before certification may proceed.
The record does not include the current release documentation showing that this regression is actually disclosed.
The record does not include any approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance for the rideshare regression.
The release-thread monitoring comment is explicitly informal context and, under policy, does not substitute for reviewed mitigation or current documentation.
Prior approval is stale relative to the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot carry the present certification decision.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the available record.
That documentation-and-monitoring posture is enough without attached current disclosure language or approved mitigation.
Any implication that prior approval of the model family materially supports the current release beyond background context.
